name: Moody Dragonfly 90
author: gksckt
description: Neon rounded pink button that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, box-shadow becomes inset 0 0 0 4px #ef476f, 
              inset 0 0 0 8px #ffd166, 
              inset 0 0 0 12px #06d6a0,
              inset 0 0 0 16px #118ab2, background changes from #fff to #073b4c, text color changes from #000 to #fff.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moody Dragonfly 90</title>
<style>
/* Moody Dragonfly 90 by gksckt — https://uiverse.io/gksckt/moody-dragonfly-90 */
.main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.btn {
  width: 170px;
  height: 60px;
  font-size: 18px;
  background: #fff;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 50px;
  color: #000;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.4s;
}

.btn:hover {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #ef476f,
              inset 0 0 0 8px #ffd166,
              inset 0 0 0 12px #06d6a0,
              inset 0 0 0 16px #118ab2;
  background: #073b4c;
  color: #fff;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn">Hover Me</button>

</body>
</html>
